root_idea.summary: The root centers on putting something later in time: postponing, delaying, or extending an appointed term.
root_idea.development: This temporal orientation extends to deferred watering and payment, prolonged life, and the staff that urges an animal onward; related lexical branches also describe pregnancy after delayed menstruation, diluted or soured milk, and fatness.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested noun, normalized to the classical citation form مِنْسَأَةٌ.
Distinct Quran-attested noun, normalized to the classical citation form نَسِيءٌ.

senses.definition: A staff or stick used to urge or drive an animal.
senses.usage_conditions: In its Quranic occurrence, the word denotes Solomon’s staff. The lexical explanation concerns the staff’s function as an instrument for urging or driving.

senses.definition: Postponement or transfer of the sacredness of a month to another month.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic usage refers to the pre-Islamic practice of postponing a sacred month, particularly transferring the sacredness of Muḥarram to Ṣafar, so that the sacred months would not impede seasonal raiding. It is condemned in the cited Quranic passage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Postponement or delay in time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general nominal expression for deferring an appointed time, distinct from the Quranic specialized reference to postponing the sacredness of a month.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To urge, drive, or propel an animal onward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of urging or driving a camel and similar animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To postpone or delay a thing, including deferring its customary time of watering.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The watering construction may mean keeping camels from water or lengthening the interval between successive waterings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prolong a person’s life or allotted term.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in constructions such as prolonging someone’s appointed term; corresponding passive usage means that a person’s life was prolonged.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold back, put back, or drive an animal away from a watering place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Explicitly attested with camels and a tank or cistern.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put someone backward; figuratively, to render him ignominious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or idiomatic extension of putting someone back.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sell on deferred payment or postpone the payment of a debt or sale price.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of credit sales and of granting extra time for payment of a debt or the price of goods.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of menstruation, to become late so that pregnancy is suspected or begins.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical usage describes delayed menstrual discharge and the resulting expectation or onset of pregnancy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mix milk with water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The mixture may be made for another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone a drink called nasʾ, namely wine or milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive usage referring to giving the named drink.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a female antelope, to lick her young immediately after its birth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject and newborn-young context are explicitly part of this lexical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become fat or begin to grow fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The description includes the regrowth of soft hair after it has fallen off.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To grant someone a delay or credit in payment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of granting a deferred payment in a sale or in the settlement of a debt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make one’s way far off or lead oneself away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attested expression describing movement to a distant place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be postponed or delayed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Equivalent in this usage to being put off or deferred.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go far off or range far away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a camel in pasture and, more generally, of a party of people going far off.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To retire or withdraw far from someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction with عَنْ expresses withdrawal or distancing from an object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask for a postponement or for credit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used when a debtor asks a creditor for more time, or when a buyer asks that payment in a sale be deferred.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman whose menstrual discharge is late and who is consequently thought to be pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reports also include a woman in whom pregnancy has appeared or begun; the wording is a nominal use associated with delayed menstruation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thin, watery milk or milk mixed with water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal designation for diluted milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wine or an intoxicating drink that dispels reason.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This meaning is reported for the vocalization نَسْءٌ, with variant attribution concerning the related forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fatness, whether its beginning or its completion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may describe fatness developing in beasts or its fully developed state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who mixes or converses with others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An example uses socializing with women, but the lexical definition itself is not restricted to that object class.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Length or prolongation of life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal expression for extended lifespan or longevity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A postponement of the payment of a debt or the price of a thing sold.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a noun or verbal noun for deferred payment and credit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A debt whose payment is deferred, or a sale made on credit for payment at a specified future time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term applies both to the deferred debt and to the credit transaction itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An official whose office was to postpone a sacred month.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The official was also called قَلَمَّسٌ; the meaning belongs to the historical institution of month postponement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something fat or beginning to grow fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive active-participial use, distinct from the institutional sense of the same headword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A means of prolonging someone’s memorial or remembrance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the conventional expression صِلَةُ الرَّحِمِ مَنْسَأَةٌ فِي الأَثَرِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman whose menstruation is delayed and who is thought or found to be pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal or descriptive form associated with delayed menstruation and pregnancy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milk that has stood, soured, and is then diluted with water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning describes milk whose consumption was delayed until it became sour and was extended with water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An interval, distance, or intervening space.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may describe being far apart from someone or something.

cautions: The Quranic مِنْسَأَتَهُ in 34:14 is normalized under مِنْسَأَةٌ. A separately reported reading, مِنْ سَأَتِهِ, is an alternative segmentation and interpretation, not an additional sense of the public headword.
The Quranic نَسِيءٌ sense is specifically the postponement of sacred-month observance; the broader senses of delayed payment remain separate under other Classical Arabic meanings.
The packet contains no Maqāyīs entry, so the root orientation is based on the supplied Lane and Mufradāt evidence.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: Mufradāt also explains the Quranic reading نَنْسَأْهَا in 2:106 as “we postpone it,” but no corresponding QAC form group or independently supplied QAC occurrence for that verb is present; it is therefore not assigned to either displayed Quranic form.
